events.event: Bank Indonesia holds its November Board of Governors meeting (RDG) on 17-18 November, with the decision due Wednesday 18 November and analysts expecting a 25 bp hike from 5.75% to 6.00%.
events.key_numbers: Current BI-Rate 5.75% (held since 18 Jun 2026) · Consensus 6.00% (+25 bp) · RDG 17-18 Nov, decision Wed 18 Nov · Rupiah Rp18,206 on 13 Nov, record intraday low about Rp18,245-18,261 · Permata base case assumes Fed +25 bp in Dec · October inflation 3.23% y/y
events.why_it_matters: A BI rate hike would make loans, mortgages and credit-card debt costlier, while a hold could leave the rupiah exposed.
events.spreading_evidence: Every broker weekly outlook leads with the RDG

events.event: The IHSG ended the week of 9-13 November up 5.82% at 5,344.41 on surging turnover, with foreign investors net buying for the week even as the rupiah hit record lows.
events.key_numbers: IHSG 5,344.41 (from 5,050.42, +5.82%) · Market cap Rp9,047 trillion (from Rp8,744 trillion, +3.47%) · Average daily value Rp23.69 trillion (+114.64% from Rp11.04 trillion) · Foreign net buy for the week about Rp462.73 billion (BEI via Liputan6; Bisnis headline says Rp467.73 billion) vs net sell Rp167.11 billion the week before · Brokers eye 5,400-5,500 resistance if 5,300 holds
events.why_it_matters: Shows whether the post-MSCI, post-Gibran-resignation panic has turned into a rebound that retail investors can trust.
events.spreading_evidence: Weekly wrap in about 10 outlets on 14 Nov

events.event: The rupiah ended the week at Rp18,206 per US dollar, weaker 0.65% on the week, after touching a record intraday low on 12 November; BI intervened in NDF, DNDF, spot and bond markets.
events.key_numbers: Close 13 Nov Rp18,206 (Bloomberg) vs Rp18,089 a week earlier (-0.65%) · JISDOR Rp18,218 vs Rp18,130 · 12 Nov intraday Rp18,261, close Rp18,239 · CORE forecast range Rp18,100-18,250 next week · Resistance Rp18,245-18,270 (Vibiznews)
events.why_it_matters: A weaker rupiah raises prices of imported goods, fuel and overseas tuition or travel.

events.event: The US Federal Reserve releases minutes of its 28 October meeting on 18 November, while markets fully price a 25 bp hike at the 9 December FOMC after hot US October CPI and Governor Waller's hawkish remarks.
events.key_numbers: Fed funds held at 3.75-4.00% on 28 Oct, with Cook and Hammack dissenting for a hike · FOMC minutes Wed 18 Nov · 25 bp hike fully priced for 9 Dec, about 10% odds of 50 bp · Bank of America sees hikes in Dec, Jan and Mar · US October retail sales Tue 17 Nov (consensus +0.2% m/m) · US October CPI +0.4% m/m
events.why_it_matters: A Fed that is raising rates pulls money out of emerging markets and pushes the rupiah weaker, shaping BI's choice the same day.

events.event: Bank Indonesia is due to publish Q3 2026 current account (balance of payments) data around Friday 20 November, which brokers expect to show a much narrower deficit than in Q2.
events.key_numbers: Expected Q3 current account deficit about US$3.3 billion vs US$12.5 billion in Q2 (Investor.id broker forecast) · Date 20 Nov per Vibiznews, unconfirmed by BI · FX reserves US$146.3 billion at end-Sep
events.why_it_matters: The current account gap is a key reason the rupiah is under pressure; a narrower deficit would ease worries.

events.event: The MPR scheduled a plenary session on 2 December 2026 to elect and inaugurate a new Vice President after Gibran's resignation, with Prabowo asked to nominate candidates, and the Finance Ministry warned political turmoil could affect Indonesia's rating.
events.key_numbers: MPR plenary 2 Dec 2026 · Prabowo reportedly asked to send two names in the week of 16 Nov (single minor outlet, unverified) · Foreign analyst call of up to 7% IHSG drop did not materialise (IHSG +5.82% on the week)
events.why_it_matters: Investors treat a smooth VP replacement as a test of political stability, which feeds into the rupiah and stock market.
events.spreading_evidence: Headline coverage across Kompas, Kontan, Viva, IDN Times on 13-14 Nov

events.event: BEI said eight companies are in its IPO pipeline as of 13 November 2026, mostly mid-sized, down from nine reported earlier in the month.
events.key_numbers: 8 companies queuing as of 13 Nov vs 9 earlier · Mostly mid-size assets · No listing dates for 16-22 Nov found
events.why_it_matters: Shows whether companies are still willing to list while the market is jittery over MSCI.
